title: Star Burst
body:
Goal: make loop art: 36 lines that make a spiky rainbow star. Tool: Scratch app (offline) with the Pen extension. Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Use your Polygon Party project, or start a new one and add the Pen extension.
  2. Build the script below. change pen color by is in Pen.
  3. Click the green flag and watch the star grow.
  4. Now try your own numbers for repeat, move and turn. Write down your favorite.
  5. Save as star-burst.

The script in words

  • when green flag clicked
  • erase all
  • go to x: -75 y: 0
  • point in direction 90
  • pen down
  • repeat 36:
    • move 150 steps
    • turn right 170 degrees
    • change pen color by 5
  • pen up

Expected behavior

36 long lines criss-cross to make a round, spiky star in the middle of the stage. The color of the lines changes a little each time, like a rainbow. The cat ends where it started.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Look at the three blocks inside the repeat block. Together they make one point of the star, and the loop does it over and over. The color block is in the Pen category.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: A big turn that is close to 180 degrees makes the lines criss-cross. A small color change each time makes a rainbow. Put move, turn right and change pen color by all inside the repeat.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Inside repeat ( ), stack move ( ) steps, then turn right ( ) degrees, then change pen color by ( ). Use the numbers from the README. Before the loop, put pen down from the Pen category, and after the loop, put pen up.
